DescribeIpInfo.description_en: Invokes DescribeIpInfo to authenticate whether a specified IP address is a Content Delivery Network (CDN) point of presence IP address
DescribeIpInfo.description_zh: 调用DescribeIpInfo验证指定的IP是否为阿里云CDN节点的IP地址

DescribeIpStatus.description_en: Queries the status of IP addresses of points of presence (POPs). The status of an IP address of a POP indicates whether content delivery acceleration is supported by the POP
DescribeIpStatus.description_zh: 调用DescribeIpStatus查询节点IP可用状态，进而根据节点IP可用状态来了解节点加速服务的可用状态

DescribeL2VipsByDomain.description_en: Queries the IP addresses of L2 nodes for a specified domain name
DescribeL2VipsByDomain.description_zh: 调用DescribeL2VipsByDomain查询指定域名的L2节点的IP地址

DescribePreloadDetailById.description_en: Queries the prefetch progress of a task, including all resources in the task. Only users who are included in the whitelist can use this operation. You can contact your business manager to apply for the whitelist
DescribePreloadDetailById.description_zh: 查询任务预热详情，包括任务下所有资源的预热进度。该接口需要申请白名单后才可以使用，带宽大于100Gbps的情况下，可以通过您的商务经理申请白名单

DescribeRangeDataByLocateAndIspService.description_en: Obtains bandwidth data by carrier and region
DescribeRangeDataByLocateAndIspService.description_zh: 调用DescribeRangeDataByLocateAndIspService获取按运营商和地域获取带宽数据

DescribeRealtimeDeliveryAcc.description_en: Queries the number of real-time log deliveries
DescribeRealtimeDeliveryAcc.description_zh: 调用DescribeRealtimeDeliveryAcc查询实时日志投递次数

DescribeRefreshQuota.description_zh: 调用DescribeRefreshQuota查询当天URL刷新、目录刷新、预热及封禁的最大限制数量和剩余量

DescribeRefreshTaskById.description_en: Use `DescribeRefreshTaskById` to check if refresh and prefetch tasks are complete across the network
DescribeRefreshTaskById.description_zh: 调用DescribeRefreshTaskById查询刷新状态和预热状态是否在全网生效

DescribeRefreshTasks.description_en: Queries whether refresh or prefetch tasks have taken effect across the entire network
DescribeRefreshTasks.description_zh: 调用DescribeRefreshTasks查询刷新、预热状态是否在全网生效

DescribeStagingIp.description_en: Queries node IP addresses in the staging environment
DescribeStagingIp.description_zh: 调用DescribeStagingIp查询模拟环境的节点IP地址

DescribeTagResources.description_en: Queries tags that are added to specified resources
DescribeTagResources.description_zh: 调用DescribeTagResources查询资源对应的标签

DescribeTopDomainsByFlow.description_en: Queries the top N domain names ranked by network traffic. You can query data collected in the last 30 days
DescribeTopDomainsByFlow.description_zh: 调用DescribeTopDomainsByFlow获取用户按流量排名的域名，支持获取最近30天的数据

DescribeUserCdnStatus.description_en: Queries the status of a user
DescribeUserCdnStatus.description_zh: 调用DescribeUserCdnStatus获取用户状态信息

DescribeUserCertificateExpireCount.description_en: Queries the number of domain names whose SSL certificates are about to expire or have already expired
DescribeUserCertificateExpireCount.description_zh: 调用DescribeUserCertificateExpireCount查询用户证书过期的域名数

DescribeUserConfigs.description_zh: 调用DescribeUserConfigs查询安全功能相关的配置

DescribeUserDomains.description_en: Queries all accelerated domain names in your Alibaba Cloud account and the status of the accelerated domain names. You can filter domain names by name or status. Fuzzy match is supported
DescribeUserDomains.description_zh: 调用DescribeUserDomains查询用户名下所有的域名与状态，支持域名模糊匹配过滤和域名状态过滤

DescribeUserUsageDataExportTask.description_en: Queries usage export tasks that were created in the last three months
DescribeUserUsageDataExportTask.description_zh: 调用DescribeUserUsageDataExportTask查询用户最近三个月的用量导出任务信息

DescribeUserUsageDetailDataExportTask.description_en: Queries tasks that were used to export resource usage details of one or more accelerated domain names that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account. Resource usage information is collected every five minutes
DescribeUserUsageDetailDataExportTask.description_zh: 调用DescribeUserUsageDetailDataExportTask查询您账户下单个或多个域名5分钟明细数据的导出任务

DescribeUserVipsByDomain.description_en: Queries virtual IP addresses (VIPs) of CDN points of presence (POPs) by domain name

DescribeVerifyContent.description_en: Queries the ownership verification content of an accelerated domain name
DescribeVerifyContent.description_zh: 调用DescribeVerifyContent查询归属校验内容

DisableRealtimeLogDelivery.description_en: Disables real-time log delivery for specific accelerated domain names
DisableRealtimeLogDelivery.description_zh: 调用DisableRealtimeLogDelivery暂停域名实时日志投递

EnableRealtimeLogDelivery.description_en: Enables real-time log delivery for an accelerated domain name
EnableRealtimeLogDelivery.description_zh: 调用EnableRealtimeLogDelivery开启域名实时日志投递

GenerateCdnDiagnose.description_en: Generates a diagnostic link for a URL
GenerateCdnDiagnose.description_zh: 调用GenerateCdnDiagnose根据访问URL生成探测工具链接

ListDomainsByLogConfigId.description_en: Queries domain names by log configuration ID
ListDomainsByLogConfigId.description_zh: 调用ListDomainsByLogConfigId按日志配置ID查询域名列表

ListFCTrigger.description_en: Queries the Function Compute trigger that is set for an Alibaba Cloud CDN event
ListFCTrigger.description_zh: 调用ListFCTrigger查询指定事件的函数计算触发器列表

ListRealtimeLogDelivery.description_en: Queries all real-time log delivery tasks within your Alibaba Cloud account
ListRealtimeLogDelivery.description_zh: 查询用户下所有实时日志投递

ListRealtimeLogDeliveryDomains.description_en: Queries all domain names that are associated with a specific real-time log delivery configuration record
ListRealtimeLogDeliveryDomains.description_zh: 调用ListRealtimeLogDeliveryDomains查询实时日志投递服务下所有域名

ListRealtimeLogDeliveryInfos.description_en: Queries real-time log delivery configurations in a specified region
ListRealtimeLogDeliveryInfos.description_zh: 调用ListRealtimeLogDeliveryInfos查询所有实时日志投递服务信息

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags that are attached to a resource
ListTagResources.description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询资源标签列表

ListUserCustomLogConfig.description_en: Queries all custom log configurations in your account
ListUserCustomLogConfig.description_zh: 调用ListUserCustomLogConfig查询用户下所有自定义日志配置信息

ModifyCdnDomain.description_zh: 调用ModifyCdnDomain修改加速域名基础信息

ModifyCdnDomainOwner.description_en: Transfer domain names from an Alibaba Cloud account to the current account
ModifyCdnDomainOwner.description_zh: 调用ModifyCdnDomainOwner将其他阿里云账号下的域名迁移至本账号

ModifyCdnDomainSchdmByProperty.description_en: Changes the acceleration region for an accelerated domain name
ModifyCdnDomainSchdmByProperty.description_zh: 调用ModifyCdnDomainSchdmByProperty通过配置组修改域名的加速区域

ModifyCdnService.description_en: Changes the metering method of Alibaba Cloud CDN

ModifyRealtimeLogDelivery.description_en: Updates real-time log delivery for a specific domain name. Each domain name supports only one Logstore
ModifyRealtimeLogDelivery.description_zh: 调用ModifyRealtimeLogDelivery更改域名实时日志投递，一个域名仅支持投递单个Logstore

OpenCdnService.description_en: Activates Alibaba Cloud CDN. You must activate Alibaba Cloud CDN before you can manage domain names in Alibaba Cloud CDN
OpenCdnService.description_zh: 调用OpenCdnService开通CDN服务。开通服务后才能进行域名操作

PublishStagingConfigToProduction.description_en: Publishes the configurations of the staging environment to the production environment
PublishStagingConfigToProduction.description_zh: 调用PublishStagingConfigToProduction将模拟环境配置发布为生产环境配置

PushObjectCache.description_en: Prefetches content from the origin server to cache nodes. This allows first-time access to directly hit the cache, reducing the load on the origin server
PushObjectCache.description_zh: 将源站的内容主动预热到缓存节点上。您首次访问可直接命中缓存，缓解源站压力

RefreshObjectCacheByCacheTag.description_en: Refreshes the cache based on cache tags that you configured
RefreshObjectCacheByCacheTag.description_zh: 当用户设置了缓存标签功能后，通过调用RefreshObjectCacheByCacheTag指定缓存标签对缓存进行刷新

RefreshObjectCaches.description_en: Refreshes file content on nodes. The cached files that are refreshed immediately become invalid. New requests retrieve the latest files from the origin server. Batch URL refresh is supported
RefreshObjectCaches.description_zh: 刷新节点上的文件内容。被刷新的文件缓存将立即失效，新的请求将回源获取最新的文件，支持URL批量刷新

RollbackStagingConfig.description_en: Rolls back configurations in the staging environment. After you call this operation, all configurations in the staging environment are cleared
RollbackStagingConfig.description_zh: 调用RollbackStagingConfig可以起到回滚模拟环境配置的作用，配置回滚后的模拟环境将被还原为初始状态，模拟环境下的所有配置都将被清空

SetCdnDomainCSRCertificate.description_en: Configures an SSL certificate for a specific domain name
SetCdnDomainCSRCertificate.description_zh: 调用SetCdnDomainCSRCertificate设置指定域名下的HTTPS证书

SetCdnDomainSMCertificate.description_en: Enables or disables a ShangMi (SM) certificate for a domain name
SetCdnDomainSMCertificate.description_zh: 调用SetCdnDomainSMCertificate设置某域名下国密证书功能是否启用

SetCdnDomainSSLCertificate.description_en: Enables or disables the certificate for a domain name and updates the certificate information
SetCdnDomainSSLCertificate.description_zh: 调用SetCdnDomainSSLCertificate用于设置某域名下证书功能是否启用及更新证书信息

SetCdnDomainStagingConfig.description_en: Configures an accelerated domain name in the staging environment
SetCdnDomainStagingConfig.description_zh: 调用SetCdnDomainStagingConfig设置模拟环境下的加速域名配置

SetCdnFullDomainsBlockIP.description_en: Blocks or unblocks IP addresses. This setting applies to all domain names in your account
SetCdnFullDomainsBlockIP.description_zh: 设置封禁的IP或解禁IP，该操作对您账号下所有的CDN域名同时生效

SetReqHeaderConfig.description_zh: 调用SetReqHeaderConfig设置回源自定义头

SetWaitingRoomConfig.description_en: Configures the virtual waiting room feature for an accelerated domain name. This operation is available only for accelerated domain names of the Dynamic CDN workload type
SetWaitingRoomConfig.description_zh: 调用SetWaitingRoomConfig设置waiting_room功能，只支持全站加速类型域名

StartCdnDomain.description_en: Enables a disabled domain name. After the domain name is enabled, the value of the DomainStatus parameter is changed to Online
StartCdnDomain.description_zh: 调用StartCdnDomain启用状态为停用的加速域名，将DomainStatus变更为Online

StopCdnDomain.description_en: Disables an accelerated domain name. After the domain name is disabled, the value of the DomainStatus parameter is changed to Offline
StopCdnDomain.description_zh: 调用StopCdnDomain停用某个加速域名，将DomainStatus变更为Offline

TagResources.description_en: Adds one or more tags to specific resources

UpdateCdnDeliverTask.description_zh: 调用UpdateCdnDeliverTask根据订阅任务ID更新已订阅的报表任务

UpdateCdnSubTask.description_en: Updates one or more operations reports
UpdateCdnSubTask.description_zh: 调用UpdateCdnSubTask更新已定制的运营报表

UpdateFCTrigger.description_en: Updates a specified Function Compute trigger
UpdateFCTrigger.description_zh: 调用UpdateFCTrigger更新指定的函数计算触发器

VerifyDomainOwner.description_en: Verifies the ownership of a specified domain name
VerifyDomainOwner.description_zh: 调用VerifyDomainOwner对域名归属权进行校验
